description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Japan statutory national-holiday date offset in 2026-2027. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need company, school, bank, exchange or prefectural closure semantics.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts dates using the pinned Japan statutory national-holiday schedule and weekend baseline.
Example user requests: Add five Japan national working days after 2027-03-19.
Inputs: start_date (date); working_days (integer).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2027-03-19","working_days":1}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, national_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_legal_bases, weekend_days, calendar_scope, rest_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: move one day at a time; decrement remaining only when Japan national status.is_working_day=true
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/japan-national-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/japan-national-add-working-days.md

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date is excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_japan_national_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

day_type.description: Regular weekday, regular weekend or statutory national holiday.

holiday_kinds.description: National holiday or statutory holiday under the Cabinet Office table.

holiday_legal_bases.description: Holiday Act or Cabinet Office legal classification.

holiday_names.description: Japanese statutory holiday names applying on the date.

rest_day_policy.description: Company, school, bank and exchange closures are not inferred.

sources.description: Official Cabinet Office and legislation sources.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Add Japan National Working Days
